reviewer: Codex primary final critical reading; selected separate-reader findings retained in evidence/reviews. No human/Claude acceptance claimed.

clarity.evidence: A five-token bucket with two tokens per second gives concrete refill and rejection arithmetic.

scope.evidence: The selected contract is an atomic shared token bucket with an explicit outage policy, not an arbitrary universal API limit.

contracts.evidence: Capacity, refill rate, cost, integer units, watermark, retry delay and expiry use consistent units across Java and Lua.

correctness.evidence: 8833 Java checks plus 19 earlier checks on pinned Redis 7.4.2; Lua hash unchanged. The exact envelope is over sampled milliseconds, with physical-time resolution slack.

failure_handling.evidence: Backward-clock debt affects both retry and TTL; state is retained until it would be full; eviction/failover and forward clock jumps have qualified guarantees.

tradeoffs.evidence: Token bucket versus sliding/window limits, shared versus local authority, key choice and fail-open/fail-closed consequences are answered.

visual_learning.evidence: RatelimitTrace records refill/spend/reject steps; the picture shows balance and time with plain text decisions.

code.evidence: examples/learning-java/src/kb/ratelimit; full copyable source/download parity and exact excerpts checked by check_review_lot.py; actual runtime output in lot-command-output.json and lot-runtime.json.

rendering.evidence: HLD-2-browser.json: article and walkthrough in light/dark at 1280/390px; theme controls, navigation, no missing images/page-wide overflow, table contrast >=4.5. Per-topic assets resolve.

limits: Local mechanism and fixture checks do not establish remote-provider behavior, distributed durability/failover, production throughput or model quality. Scope-specific boundaries are explicit in the answer.
